docs.titre: Holidays and celebrations in Tunisia and abroad
docs.contenu:
🎯 Objectives
- I can name holidays and celebrations in Tunisia and in other countries.
- I can say what people do on these special days.

🔍 Warm-up
Photo talk! Look at pictures: new clothes, a cake with candles, lights, a flag. What holiday is it? Talk together: What is your favourite celebration?

📘 New words & structures
Celebrations: Eid, Ramadan, Independence Day, New Year, birthday, wedding.
Words: present, cake, candle, new clothes, family, visit, flag, party.
Structures:
- We celebrate Eid with our family.
- Children wear new clothes and get presents.
- On my birthday, I have a cake with candles.
- On Independence Day, we see the Tunisian flag everywhere.
- Happy Eid! Happy New Year! Happy birthday!

✏️ Practice examples
1. On Eid morning, we visit our grandparents. We eat sweet cakes.
2. In Ramadan, families eat together in the evening.
3. On New Year's Day, people around the world say: Happy New Year!
4. On my birthday, my friends sing: Happy birthday to you!

🛠️ How to say it
To talk about a celebration:
1. Name the day: On Eid... / On my birthday...
2. Say what you do: ...we visit family / ...I eat cake.
3. Add a wish: Happy Eid! Happy birthday!

⭐ Remember
- Use ON with special days: on Eid, on my birthday.
- People in different countries have different celebrations, and all of them are beautiful!
- Say the wish with a big smile: Happy...!

🔗 Try at home
Choose your favourite celebration. Draw it and write two sentences: the name of the day and one thing your family does. Then teach your family the wish in English!

📋 Summary
Celebrations include Eid, Ramadan, Independence Day, New Year, birthday and wedding. On these special days people share presents, cake and candles, new clothes and flags, and families visit each other. We use ON with special days: on Eid, on my birthday, and we describe what we do: We celebrate Eid with our family. To wish someone well we say Happy Eid!, Happy New Year! or Happy birthday! with a big smile. Every country has different celebrations, and all of them are beautiful — draw your favourite one and teach your family its English wish.

enonce.question: Choose: On Eid, children wear ___ clothes. (new / old / wet)
Match: On a birthday, there is a ___ with candles. (cake / flag / bus)
Fill in: We say Happy ___ Year on the first of January.
Choose: On Independence Day, we see the Tunisian ___. (flag / cake / bike)
Fill in: ___ my birthday, I get presents. (On / At / By)
Put the words in order: celebrate / We / with our family / Eid
Choose the correct wish: (a) Happy birthday to you! (b) Happy birthday at you!
Write two sentences about your favourite celebration: its name and one thing your family does.
What do families do in Ramadan evenings? Write one sentence.
Correct the mistake: We celebrates Eid in Tunisia.
